name: context_info
description: Return metadata about a role's conversation: context window size, estimated current prompt tokens, last reported prompt tokens, remaining budget, and a per-message snapshot (index, role, content length, reasoning length). Without targetRole the metadata describes your own conversation; with targetRole it describes that suspended role instance's conversation.

detailed: Returns metadata about the current conversation context.

targetRole.description: Optional role-instance id (for example "coder-1-4") of a suspended role whose conversation should be inspected. Must name a live instance other than your own. Omit to inspect your own conversation.
